Gal Dayan

#### What's great

the "you're not on the map yet" result when you search your own handle is a smart touch, it turns an empty state into a reason to post on X instead of a dead end. the map itself is fun to poke around, real profiles clustered by city, and random boats sailing the ocean tiles for flavor. ranking column wasn't obvious to me at a glance but the core idea, seeing the maker world as an actual map instead of a feed, works

#### What needs improvement

a legend for what the points/ranking column actually measures would help, right now it's not clear if it's X engagement, on-site activity, or something else

Martijn Verbove

results.title: Best Map Animation Maker Alternatives (2026) | Animaps
results.content:
| Google Earth Studio | Free photorealistic 3D Earth flyovers with keyframes, plus camera export to After Effects. | Access is by request, desktop Chrome only, local renders are image sequences, and Google offers no commercial licence for the imagery. | Animaps vs Google Earth Studio → |
| MapAnimation.io | One-off AI map clips from a text prompt, with image, video and sprite uploads. | Their site describes re-prompting rather than editing the output, and no plan table was visible on their pricing page in August 2026. | Animaps vs MapAnimation.io → | [...] | Mapimator | Projects and keyframes with an AI Director, and 4K export on the $12 Pro plan. | The free tier allows 1 export per month at 480p, and Pro includes 50 AI Director prompts per month. | Animaps vs Mapimator → |
| anim8map | One 3D travel route video with stops, travel modes and your photos, sold per video. | Made for trip recaps rather than borders, labels or highlights, and Full HD at most on premium. | Animaps vs anim8map → |
| TravelBoast | Travel recaps made on a phone, with GPX import, photos at each stop, 250+ vehicles and 4K on a subscription. | An iOS and Android app with no PC version, shaped around one journey rather than borders, labels or historical maps. | Animaps vs TravelBoast → | [...] | Kepler.gl | Free, open source exploration of large location datasets, with filters, hexbins, heatmaps and time playback. | An analysis tool rather than a video maker: its video export records WebM or GIF clips of up to 10 seconds, in 16:9 or 4:3. | Animaps vs Kepler.gl → |
| Flourish | Interactive charts and maps for the web from 50+ templates, including choropleth maps, 3D globes and animated 3D maps. | Built for readers who explore on a page: video export works from stories only and is a premium feature the Flourish team turns on. | Animaps vs Flourish → |
